s: that which is important; that which matters; a sine qua non
Gute Kohle ist das A und O beim Grillen.
Good charcoal is the most important part of barbecuing.
Die Entwicklung eines guten Sprachgefühls ist das A und O beim Erlernen einer Fremdsprache.
The development of a good intuitive grasp of a language is the sine qua non in the learning of a foreign language.
A und O.et: From Ancient Greek. From the biblical book of Revelation, verses 1:8 and 22:13. The expression refers to God as “the beginning and the end”, the letter omega being the last of the Greek alphabet.
